segments.name: Solar PV products
segments.description: Manufactures and sells solar PV products, including solar cables and solar connectors, to customers.
segments.evidence: We are a solar PV product provider principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of solar cables and solar connectors.

segments.name: High performance computing products
segments.description: Offers customers new and used GPU and HPC servers, alongside partnerships with IC chip manufacturers.
segments.evidence: We also actively cultivate partnerships with multiple IC chip manufacturers and offer customers new and used GPU and HPC servers.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for the solar PV products and HPC products it sells.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue from sales of solar PV products accounted for 97.37% and 93.23% of our total revenues for the fiscal years ended September 30, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
